fields.title: 📖 Quss ibn Saʿīdah: Barāʾah from shirk
fields.body:
🖋️ **From Quss ibn Saʿīdah al-Iyādī** it is transmitted:

***“Truly, Allah has a religion that is more beloved to Him than your religion, upon which you stand.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement shows **barāʾah** (disavowal) from **shirk** (associating partners) and a general judgment about a religion of shirk, without judging a specific person by name. Precisely here lies the difference between **takfīr bil-ʿumūm** (a general judgment) and **takfīr al-muʿayyan** (a judgment about a specific person).

immutable.source: 📝 al-Ṭabarānī, al-Muʿjam al-Kabīr, Teil 25, Nr. 2019, S. 231–232.
